ideas.title: Promotion and relegation between divisions
ideas.what: Divisions are ranked. Finish at the top of a lower division and you move up next season; finish at the bottom of a higher one and you move down. Your division sets your schedule.
ideas.why: Keeps the bottom of the standings playing for something late in the year.
ideas.catch: Seen in another league that started it this season, so there is no track record yet.
